format.description: The output graph format. makefile2graph specifically generates Graphviz DOT format.

make_cmd.description: The command used to invoke GNU Make.

makefile_path.description: The path to the Makefile to parse for dependencies.

always_make.description: If true, behaves as if all targets were remade from scratch (-B/--always-make).

output.description: The destination for the generated graph. 'stdout' for console, or a file path.
